about: The one file the shop maintains for the chat assistant on the home page. facts: what the assistant may state, each with its status (published = the shop says so today; disputed = the shop’s own pages disagree; proposed = in the plan, not confirmed; example = a stand-in). Menu items and prices come from assets/menu.json, never from here. Change a fact here and the assistant says the new thing on the next load.
endpoint_note: Set window.CHEF_CHAT_ENDPOINT on the page (or endpoint here) to a Worker URL and the widget POSTs {message, history, page, bag} and expects {reply, actions, cites}; every answer still passes the engine’s guard (no price, time or item outside the records). Without it, the rules in the browser answer.

strings.title: Need help? We are glad to help!
strings.disclosure: Automated assistant: it answers from the shop’s own menu and pages. A person reads any message you leave for the kitchen. No message text is stored here.
strings.greeting: Bonjour! Ask me about the case, prices, hours, ordering ahead, gluten-free, cakes, the class or the Thanksgiving box.
strings.dont_know: I do not know that yet; the shop can tell you. Leave a message for the kitchen, or call during opening hours.
strings.leave_title: Leave a message for the kitchen
strings.leave_note: This preview cannot send mail by itself: your message is kept on this device and the button opens your mail app with it filled in. In the new store it reaches the shop directly.
strings.sent: Saved on this device. Your mail app has the message ready to send.
strings.placeholder: Ask about the menu, hours, ordering…

address.text: 169 W Green St, Old Pasadena, CA 91105, one door from La Cave at 163.

plant_based.text: Everything is vegan: the first French vegan pastry shop in Los Angeles, no butter, milk or eggs anywhere in the case. La Cave next door is a vegan wine bar.

hours_bakery.text: The shop’s contact page lists Tuesday 9 am to 3 pm and Wednesday to Sunday 6 am to 3 pm; its About page lists later closings, so please call 626-365-1161 to confirm today’s hours.
hours_bakery.source: id-eclair.com/pages/contact and /pages/about-the-shop, read 28 Oct and 2 Nov 2026

la_cave.text: La Cave is the same kitchen’s vegan wine bar next door at 163 W Green St: French, organic, biodynamic and vegan wines, small plates, Rebel Cheese boards and plated desserts paired with a glass. Open Wednesday to Sunday, 3 to 9 pm, as published on its own site (which gives 169 as the address; the shop confirms one).

masterclass.text: The Macaron Masterclass is hands-on, Tuesdays 3:30 to 5:30 pm, $125 a seat, 20 to 30 macarons to take home; seats are very limited, and today it is booked with the shop.
masterclass.source: live store Golden Ticket listing; classes.html

class_cutoff.text: In the new store, seat sales close 48 hours before class.

golden_ticket.text: The Golden Ticket is a class pass with an organic chocolate tablet, $140 on the live store; the person who receives it arranges the date with the shop.

custom_cake_notice.text: Custom cakes need one week’s notice, the shop’s own rule. Tell the chef the occasion, the guests and the flavour on the cakes page and get a sketch and a price back.

wedding_cake_notice.text: Wedding cakes book four weeks out, by consultation.

bespoke_consult.text: Bespoke and wedding cakes start with a paid consultation, $50, credited to the cake, then a sketch and a quote, with the deposit and balance by Shopify invoice.

cake_addons.text: A message plaque and candles are priced add-ons on menu cakes.

cake_estimate_rule.text: Price-from estimate for the concept: the smallest guest count for the size, at $15 a guest, the counter’s price for one individual mousse cake. The kitchen’s own price grid replaces it; the playbook lists that grid among the owners’ items.
cake_estimate_rule.source: demo/assets/menu.json, mousse-cake ($15, menu app 2026-10-21); agency/clients/id-eclair/plan/PLAYBOOK_FINAL_2026-10-22.md, section 10 and owners’ checklist (cake sizes, flavours, price grid)

cake_sizes.text: Example sizes for the concept, matching the shared cakes page: 6-inch for 4 to 6, 8-inch for 7 to 12, 10-inch for 13 to 20, two tiers for 21 to 40, three tiers planned with the chef.
cake_sizes.source: demo/cakes.html, size step (example sizes); agency/clients/id-eclair/research/client_references.md, findings 13 and 19

pickup_lead.text: Choose a day and a time when you order and it is boxed for then. The live store today says orders are usually ready in 24 hours; in the new checkout same-day pickup opens 30 minutes after you order.
pickup_lead.source: live store listings; plan section 4.3 for the 30 minutes

box_of_six.text: Six macarons are $15 at the counter, and you choose the six. The assorted box on the live store is $18. Flavours on the shop’s listing: raspberry, pistachio, chocolate, coffee and coconut; the day’s bake decides what is in the case.
box_of_six.source: demo/assets/menu.json, macaron-box-6 and macarons; demo/assets/README.md, colour rules

afternoon_tea.text: Tea party for two is $80 at the salon, with the chef’s selection of sweets and savouries; each extra guest is $40, while supplies last. It is booked ahead.

gluten_board.text: The counter board marks the soup du jour as gluten-free, and the endive and grandmother beet salades as gluten-free without their crostini.

gluten_store.text: The live store labels these gluten free in a product title or tag: the assorted macarons, cannelés by 3, the four dessert jars and their discovery box, the chocolate fingers, the cookie spoons, both truffle boxes, the Kushyflakes and the large gift basket.
gluten_store.source: brain_state/clients/eng-0002/site_audit/products.json (the live store’s products.json, read 2026-10-22): store titles and tags

gluten_caution.text: Gluten-free on a label means the shop’s own labelling; the kitchen also bakes croissants and baguettes. If it matters for your health, ask the counter before you order.

allergens.text: The shop has not published an allergen chart yet, so nothing here is promised nut-free: almonds are in the macarons, the jars’ streusel and the sablés, and the kitchen works with nuts, soy and wheat. Ask at the counter or leave a message with your allergy and the kitchen answers.
allergens.source: live store listings and the counter board; chart pending

fees.text: The price on the menu is the price at checkout. No service fee; a tip line in the new checkout is optional.
fees.source: plan section 4; the shop has not confirmed the tip line

payment.text: Most major credit cards are accepted, as well as Google Pay and Apple Pay.
payment.source: id-eclair.com FAQ, What payments are supported

delivery.text: Today the shop delivers through Uber Eats, DoorDash and Grubhub, and the live store ships shelf items in the United States: standard shipping $19 to $25, 2 to 3 business days, no PO boxes, no international. Pickup at 169 W Green St is the way to get the case itself.
delivery.source: id-eclair.com About the shop and Shipping policy, read 2 Nov 2026

gift_cards.text: Gift cards are planned for the new store: $25, $50, $100 and $150, no expiry and no fees, and under California law a balance under $10 is paid in cash on request. Today the Golden Ticket ($140, a masterclass seat) and the gift baskets are the gifts on the live store.
gift_cards.source: California Civil Code 1749.5; the amounts are an example until the shop confirms

gift_note.text: In the build the gift note rides on the order as a Shopify cart note. In this preview it stays on your screen.
gift_note.source: agency/clients/id-eclair/plan/PLAYBOOK_FINAL_2026-10-22.md, section 3 (a gift note previewed as a card, with a send date)

carnet.text: Le carnet, the proposed loyalty programme: 1 point per $1, 50 points take $3 off, a pastry or drink in your birthday month.

parking.text: Street parking around Green Street is paid; there are outdoor tables and dogs are welcome, say the reviewers.
parking.source: Yelp and Google reviews, read 21 Oct 2026

holiday_preorder.text: The Thanksgiving box for two is on the live store, $100 to $185 by option, pickup only 11 to 26 November at 3 pm, ordered 48 hours ahead. Christmas boxes open when the kitchen posts them; order ahead and choose your pickup day.
holiday_preorder.source: id-eclair.com product listing, Thanksgiving box for 2, read 22 Oct 2026

catering.text: For an office, a family table or a wedding: the cheese board for ten is $100 and the 600 g truffle box is $30 on the live store today; trays, printed cookies and bigger tables start with the catering request, and the kitchen answers with what it can make by then and a price.
catering.source: live store listings; the request page is a concept
